spans.s: 1 पौर॑ m. filler, increaser.
2 पौर m. townsman, citizen.
पौरकार्य n. the citizens' affairs.
पौरजन m. townsfolk, the citizens.

पौरंदर a. belonging to the destroyer of the castles
(Indra).
पौरस्त्य a. foremost, eastern.
पौरस्त्यपवन m. east wind.
पौराणिक f. ई = prec., also knowing the past.
पौरिक m. townsman, citizen.
पौरुहूत a. relating to Puruhūta-Indra.
पौरूरवस a. belonging to Purūravas.

पौरोगव m. inspector of a royal household, esp. of the
kitchen.
पौरोभाग्य n. envy, malevolence.
पौरोहित्य n. the office of a house-priest.
पौर्णमास्य n. full-moon sacrifice.
पौर्त w. कर्मन् n. a meritorious work.
पौर्तिक a. relating to a meritorious work.

पौर्वदेहिक a. relating to a former life or
existence.

पौर्व˚दैहिक a. relating to a former life or
existence.

पौर्वाह्लिक f. ई belonging to the morning,
matutinal, as s. mat. ceremony.
पौर्विक f. ई former, ancient, old.
